notes.title: Gameplay Trailer #2: Rotor Clash
notes.content:
Gunship pilots!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415715/a61c40777230ecb29b542b0e5364759df8f18d9c.gif"]

The Viper Commando proudly presents the second gameplay trailer of COBRA STRIKE.

Discover your favorite and freshly arrived gunships, choppers, aircraft and watch them in close-range combat and action-packed encounters.


Watch the new gameplay trailer here:[previewyoutube="YXWuSImcECs;full"][/previewyoutube]


Some new rotors and wings were directly suggested here by the Steam Community:

Thanks to BlackjackGT, TigerPAH2, Daredevil_314 and Orc01!

Much appreciated!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415715/d99a4ab5ef2e651211d41ae6327a2b04691053df.gif"]

Thank you for all your input!

You're are shaping COBRA STRIKE already in the right direction and to its ideal form. Let's make it the best together! Blast from the past - right into an aspiring retro gaming future!



Meanwhile your squad leader continues development of a playable version, 
so that you can shape COBRA STRIKE even more regarding, piloting, aiming, targeting and combating.

Enlist here to do so or leave a comment in the Discussions here.



Playable Chopper list, F.A.Q. and Feature Requests were updated too.



Also participate in the new community survey in the Steam Discussions regarding new feature requests and game design decisions - your feedback matters!



Stay tuned for further intel and updates!



Dismissed!

-somasolo
